    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Rust 中的 Tokio 线程同步机制</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文分享自天翼云开发者社区《<a href="https://www.ctyun.cn/developer/article/579088696864837" rel="noopener nofollow">Rust 中的 Tokio 线程同步机制</a>》，作者：l****n</p>
<h3>Rust 中的 Tokio 线程同步机制</h3>
<p>在并发编程中，线程同步是一个重要的概念，用于确保多个线程在访问共享资源时能够正确地协调。Tokio 是一个强大的异步运行时库，为 Rust 提供了多种线程同步机制。以下是一些常见的同步机制：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Mutex</strong></li>
<li><strong>RwLock</strong></li>
<li><strong>Barrier</strong></li>
<li><strong>Semaphore</strong></li>
<li><strong>Notify</strong></li>
<li><strong>oneshot 和 mpsc 通道</strong></li>
<li><strong>watch 通道</strong></li>
</ol>
<h3>1. Mutex</h3>
<p><code>Mutex</code>（互斥锁）是最常见的同步原语之一，用于保护共享数据。它确保同一时间只有一个线程能够访问数据，从而避免竞争条件。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::Mutex;
<span class="hljs-keyword">use std::sync::Arc;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">data = Arc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(Mutex::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(<span class="hljs-number">0));
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-keyword">mut <span class="hljs-variable">handles = <span class="hljs-built_in">vec![];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">_ <span class="hljs-keyword">in <span class="hljs-number">0..<span class="hljs-number">10 {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">data = data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
            <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-keyword">mut <span class="hljs-variable">lock = data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">lock().<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
            *lock += <span class="hljs-number">1;
        });
        handles.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">push(handle);
    }
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">handle <span class="hljs-keyword">in handles {
        handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    }
​
    <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Result: {}", *data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">lock().<span class="hljs-keyword">await);
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>2. RwLock</h3>
<p><code>RwLock</code>（读写锁）允许多线程同时读取数据，但只允许一个线程写入数据。它比&nbsp;<code>Mutex</code>&nbsp;更加灵活，因为在读取多于写入的场景下，它能提高性能。功能上，他是读写互斥、写写互斥、读读兼容。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::RwLock;
<span class="hljs-keyword">use std::sync::Arc;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">data = Arc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(RwLock::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(<span class="hljs-number">0));
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">read_data = data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">read_handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">lock = read_data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">read().<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
        <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Read: {}", *lock);
    });
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">write_data = data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">write_handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-keyword">mut <span class="hljs-variable">lock = write_data.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">write().<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
        *lock += <span class="hljs-number">1;
        <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Write: {}", *lock);
    });
​
    read_handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    write_handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>3. Barrier</h3>
<p><code>Barrier</code>&nbsp;是一种同步机制，允许多个线程在某个点上进行同步。当线程到达屏障时，它们会等待直到所有线程都到达，然后一起继续执行。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::Barrier;
<span class="hljs-keyword">use std::sync::Arc;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">barrier = Arc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(Barrier::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(<span class="hljs-number">3));
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-keyword">mut <span class="hljs-variable">handles = <span class="hljs-built_in">vec![];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">i <span class="hljs-keyword">in <span class="hljs-number">0..<span class="hljs-number">3 {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">barrier = barrier.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
            <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Before wait: {}", i);
            barrier.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">wait().<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
            <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"After wait: {}", i);
        });
        handles.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">push(handle);
    }
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">handle <span class="hljs-keyword">in handles {
        handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    }
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>4. Semaphore</h3>
<p><code>Semaphore</code>（信号量）是一种用于控制对资源访问的同步原语。它允许多个线程访问资源，但有一个最大并发数限制。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::test]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">test_sem() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">semaphore = Arc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(Semaphore::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(<span class="hljs-number">3));
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-keyword">mut <span class="hljs-variable">handles = <span class="hljs-built_in">vec![];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">i <span class="hljs-keyword">in <span class="hljs-number">0..<span class="hljs-number">5 {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">semaphore = semaphore.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
            <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">permit = semaphore.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">acquire().<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
            <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">now = Local::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">now();
            <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Got permit: {} at {:?}", i, now);
            <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(
                <span class="hljs-string">"Semaphore available permits before sleep: {}",
                semaphore.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">available_permits()
            );
            <span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">sleep(Duration::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">from_secs(<span class="hljs-number">5)).<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
            <span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">drop(permit);
            <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(
                <span class="hljs-string">"Semaphore available permits after sleep: {}",
                semaphore.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">available_permits()
            );
        });
        handles.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">push(handle);
    }
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for <span class="hljs-variable">handle <span class="hljs-keyword">in handles {
        handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    }
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><strong>最终的结果如下</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-apache" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-attribute">Got permit: <span class="hljs-number">0 at <span class="hljs-number">2024-<span class="hljs-number">08-<span class="hljs-number">08T21:<span class="hljs-number">03:<span class="hljs-number">04.<span class="hljs-number">374666+<span class="hljs-number">08:<span class="hljs-number">00
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits before sleep: <span class="hljs-number">2
<span class="hljs-attribute">Got permit: <span class="hljs-number">1 at <span class="hljs-number">2024-<span class="hljs-number">08-<span class="hljs-number">08T21:<span class="hljs-number">03:<span class="hljs-number">04.<span class="hljs-number">375527800+<span class="hljs-number">08:<span class="hljs-number">00
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits before sleep: <span class="hljs-number">1
<span class="hljs-attribute">Got permit: <span class="hljs-number">2 at <span class="hljs-number">2024-<span class="hljs-number">08-<span class="hljs-number">08T21:<span class="hljs-number">03:<span class="hljs-number">04.<span class="hljs-number">375563+<span class="hljs-number">08:<span class="hljs-number">00
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits before sleep: <span class="hljs-number">0
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits after sleep: <span class="hljs-number">0
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits after sleep: <span class="hljs-number">0
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits after sleep: <span class="hljs-number">1
<span class="hljs-attribute">Got permit: <span class="hljs-number">3 at <span class="hljs-number">2024-<span class="hljs-number">08-<span class="hljs-number">08T21:<span class="hljs-number">03:<span class="hljs-number">09.<span class="hljs-number">376722800+<span class="hljs-number">08:<span class="hljs-number">00
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits before sleep: <span class="hljs-number">1
<span class="hljs-attribute">Got permit: <span class="hljs-number">4 at <span class="hljs-number">2024-<span class="hljs-number">08-<span class="hljs-number">08T21:<span class="hljs-number">03:<span class="hljs-number">09.<span class="hljs-number">376779200+<span class="hljs-number">08:<span class="hljs-number">00
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits before sleep: <span class="hljs-number">1
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits after sleep: <span class="hljs-number">2
<span class="hljs-attribute">Semaphore available permits after sleep: <span class="hljs-number">3
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>5. Notify</h3>
<p><code>Notify</code>&nbsp;是一种用于线程间通知的简单机制。它允许一个线程通知其他线程某些事件的发生。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::Notify;
<span class="hljs-keyword">use std::sync::Arc;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">notify = Arc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new(Notify::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">new());
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">notify_clone = notify.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">clone();
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">handle = tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        notify_clone.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">notified().<span class="hljs-keyword">await;
        <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Received notification");
    });
​
    notify.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">notify_one();
    handle.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>6. oneshot 和 mpsc 通道</h3>
<p><code>oneshot</code>&nbsp;通道用于一次性发送消息，而&nbsp;<code>mpsc</code>&nbsp;通道则允许多个生产者发送消息到一个消费者。一般地onshot用于异常通知、启动分析等功能。mpsc用于实现异步消息同步</p>
<h4>oneshot</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::oneshot;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let (tx, rx) = oneshot::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">channel();
​
    tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        tx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">send(<span class="hljs-string">"Hello, world!").<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    });
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">message = rx.<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Received: {}", message);
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h4>mpsc</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::mpsc;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let (tx, <span class="hljs-keyword">mut rx) = mpsc::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">channel(<span class="hljs-number">32);
​
    tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        tx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">send(<span class="hljs-string">"Hello, world!").<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    });
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">while <span class="hljs-keyword">let <span class="hljs-variable">Some(message) = rx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">recv().<span class="hljs-keyword">await {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Received: {}", message);
    }
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<h3>7. watch 通道</h3>
<p><code>watch</code>&nbsp;通道用于发送和接收共享状态的更新。它允许多个消费者监听状态的变化。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-rust" data-highlighted="yes"><span class="hljs-keyword">use tokio::sync::watch;
​
<span class="hljs-meta">#[tokio::main]
<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">fn <span class="hljs-title function_">main() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">let (tx, <span class="hljs-keyword">mut rx) = watch::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">channel(<span class="hljs-string">"initial");
​
    tokio::<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">spawn(<span class="hljs-keyword">async <span class="hljs-keyword">move {
        tx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">send(<span class="hljs-string">"updated").<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">unwrap();
    });
​
    <span class="hljs-keyword">while rx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">changed().<span class="hljs-keyword">await.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">is_ok() {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">println!(<span class="hljs-string">"Received: {}", *rx.<span class="hljs-title function_ invoke__">borrow());
    }
}
</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p>​<strong>watch通道</strong>​：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>用于广播状态更新，一个生产者更新状态，多个消费者获取最新状态。</strong></li>
<li><strong>适合配置变更、状态同步等场景。</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>​<strong>mpsc通道</strong>​：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>用于传递消息队列，多个生产者发送消息，一个消费者逐条处理。</strong></li>
<li><strong>适合任务队列、事件驱动等场景。</strong></li>
</ul>
<h3>总结</h3>
<p><strong>Rust 中的 Tokio 提供了丰富的线程同步机制，可以根据具体需求选择合适的同步原语。常用的同步机制包括：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li><code>Mutex</code>：互斥锁，保护共享数据。</li>
<li><code>RwLock</code>：读写锁，允许并发读，写时独占。</li>
<li><code>Barrier</code>：屏障，同步多个线程在某一点。</li>
<li><code>Semaphore</code>：信号量，控制并发访问资源。</li>
<li><code>Notify</code>：通知机制，用于线程间通知。</li>
<li><code>oneshot</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code>mpsc</code>&nbsp;通道：消息传递机制。</li>
<li><code>watch</code>&nbsp;通道：状态更新机制。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>通过这些同步机制，可以在 Rust 中编写高效、安全的并发程序。</strong></p>
</div>
